audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers read Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Olaf; the packet levelChart reads Olaf/Skill/Camille/Camille/Skill/Camille/Olaf, and rows 0-5 of the packet are exactly what the whys[] say.
audit.why: whys[0] 'win first contact' is an Olaf row marked Skill; whys[1] 'genuinely even' is a Skill row marked Olaf; whys[2] 'her window edges yours' and whys[3] 'out-trade your short combo' are Camille rows marked Olaf/Skill; whys[5] 'let her reset and out-duel you' is a Camille row marked Olaf.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group to Olaf, Skill, Camille, Camille, (Skill), Camille, (Olaf). Row 6 left alone — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was written as 'Ragnarok deletes her R isolation lockdown', which the mirror audit already found stated in contradictory ways. Ragnarok has no cleanse and no damage component.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf R (100/90/80s): 'passively gains increased armor and magic resist... become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.' Riot text, Camille R (140/115/90s): 'dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area.' Whether the anchor counts as a disable is not answerable from Riot's text, so no claim either way is made — the verifiable statement is that Hookshot's knockup cannot stop Olaf while Ragnarok is up and he keeps swinging.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rebuilt on the knockup-versus-immunity interaction and the attack-conditional wording; the R-cleanse claim removed rather than reversed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors repeated throughout. (1) Hookshot (E, 16/15/14/13/12s) is called a STUN in whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], early, mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]; it is a knockup. (2) 'W true-damage cone' in whys[3], mid and wants.foe[1] — Tactical Sweep (W, 15/14/13/12/11s) deals ordinary damage, with the outer half slowing, dealing extra and healing her. The true damage is on Precision Protocol (Q, 9/8/7/6/5s), which whys[5] and spikes[3] already get right.
audit.why: Riot text, Camille E: 'pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.' Riot text, Camille W: 'blasts in a cone after a delay... Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.' The trueDamage flag sits on Q, not W. The distinction matters: a knockup is what Ragnarok's disable-immunity answers, and the healing half of W is why Grievous Wounds beats her, not resistances.
audit.corrected: Knockup used everywhere the stun was claimed; true damage moved to Precision Protocol; Tactical Sweep described as the slow-and-heal cone.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W-omnivamp' in whys[4], mid and wants.you[1]. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s. No healing.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with missing health — already named correctly in whys[0] and early.
audit.corrected: Named as the shield in all three.

edits.before: Camille has no E hookshot stun at level 1, so first contact is yours — sling Undertow to slow her, walk up for the auto, and let Berserker Rage attack speed punish her. The moment she hits 2 and has E, the lane shifts: she can wall-dash straight out of your Q-slow and hookshot-stun you back, so don't blow your axe when she's hugging a wall. Pick the axe up to refund Q and keep her slowed, but respect that her stun is now the thing that turns a trade against you.
edits.after: Camille has no Hookshot at level 1, so first contact is yours — sling Undertow to slow her, walk up for the auto, and let Berserker Rage attack speed punish her. The moment she hits 2 and has E, the lane shifts: she can wall-dash straight out of your Q-slow and knock you up on the landing, so don't blow your axe when she's hugging a wall. Pick the axe up to refund Q and keep her slowed, but respect that the 16s Hookshot is now what turns a trade against you.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are hers to bully if you misstep — her E stun plus W true-damage cone heal lets her win short trades and reset on the wall before your slow sticks. Hold your tempo for 6: Ragnarok strips her R isolation lockdown and ignores the E stun and W slow entirely, so you can E-true-damage and W-omnivamp her down inside your unstoppable window. That ult-up moment is your cleanest kill all lane — bait her E, then commit when Ragnarok is live.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are hers to bully if you misstep — Hookshot's knockup plus Tactical Sweep's outer-half heal let her win short trades and reset on the wall before your slow sticks. Hold your tempo for 6: Ragnarok makes that knockup useless while you keep attacking, so Reckless Swing's true damage and the Tough It Out shield carry the all-in. That ult-up moment is your cleanest kill all lane — bait her E, then commit when Ragnarok is live.
